page.title: Beach Resort Management Software: Try Summer Booking Hub
page.description: Cloud-based management software for beach resorts to increase sales and margins with no hidden costs.

hero.title: Vision, visibility, control.
hero.description: Summer Booking Hub is the next-generation management platform that opens new horizons for your beach resort.

image.alt: Lighthouse overlooking a beach equipped with umbrellas

management.title: Beach Management System
management.description: Not just a tool, but a next-generation cloud management platform that simplifies your work and frees up time and resources, helping you grow and improve.

all.title: All in one
all.intro: Online and offline bookings, interactive map, price lists, packages and extra services: manage everything from a single place.
all.detail: Customer records, personalised quotes and tailored marketing.

agility.title: Maximum operational agility
agility.intro: Access from anywhere, on any device, even with the most basic connection. Secure cloud, automatic backups and updates.
agility.detail: Set-up is quick and training is fast: you are fully operational right away.

control.title: Targeted control
control.intro: Real-time reports and statistics to monitor sales, costs, revenue and how the season is going.
control.detail: Manage prices, roles, inventory and staff with maximum efficiency.

reserve.title: +30% bookings
reserve.intro: From online to the beach. Thanks to how easy it is to book and to offer targeted deals and discounts, our customers have grown their bookings by up to 30% a year.
reserve.detail: Do you want double-digit growth too?

explode.title: +30,000 online bookings
explode.intro: Cover every online channel: from the Summer Booking portal and app to your website, Instagram and Facebook.
explode.detail: The trend is clear: the numbers are already significant and set to keep growing.

services.title: +50% extra service sales
services.intro: From SUP to parking, from bikes to drinks under the umbrella. Everything is easier to offer and easier to buy.
services.detail: Increase revenue and turnover with minimal effort.
